page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a handwritten/marginal inscription runs vertically in the left margin (not printed text); show-through from the reverse side appears faintly. Running head at top; page number top left; a woodcut/ornament at the foot. Notes: none printed as marginal text.

main_text.p: Temporibus mores mutari posse, lacertus Humano gaudens admonet intuitu.
main_text.head: Formosa & deformis par conditio.
main_text.p: Albus olor coruúsque niger dant debita morti Corpora: tardius hæc, ocyus illa rapit.
Ne Nigrina dole: ne fis, Albina, superba: Candida, nigra pari iure modóque cadunt.
main_text.head: Ad illud Iuuenalis, Cùm de te splendida Minos fecerit arbitria. Æquamors diuiti & pauperi.
main_text.p: Minois vocitas arbitria splendida: quare? Nam mors splendoris nil tenebrosa gerit.
Nêpe quòd vrna capax, nome dum cômouet omne, Non inopum tantum tangere raftra solet: Induperatorum sed versat gemmea sceptra, Splendentésque quatit nobilitate domos.
Æquat mors magnum paruo diadema ligoni: Non Minois, sed numinis arbitrio.
main_text.head: Mortui in Christo coronantur.
main_text.p: Mos erat antiquis, vt quos ex turbne vitæ In portum stiterat non revocanda dies, Impositam ferrent supremo fine corollam Victricis palmæ, quæ nota læta foret.
Da Lauros: moriens peccatis euolo liber: Et Christi dat mors certa trophæa mihi.
main_text.head: Manus humana præstantia. Ex Galeno lib. de vsu part. corp. humani.
main_text.p: Præstat equus celeri cursu: bos robore, mole Barrus, homo mira dexteritate manus.

page.notes: Vertical manuscript inscription in the left margin and faint show-through from the reverse page; the foot ornament is decorative. Some words in the scan are uncertain (e.g. "raftra", "Barrus", "euolo") and are transcribed as seen.
